basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Durg Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Assistant Programmer & Accountant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Durg is recruiting candidates for 4 contract posts, comprising Assistant Programmer (2) and Accountant (2). Eligible applicants can apply through the prescribed offline application process, sending the completed application by Registered Post or Speed Post to कार्यालय, मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जिला पंचायत दुर्ग, जिला दुर्ग छ.ग on or before 30 October 2026, starting from 12 October 2026. Qualifications differ by post, requiring M.Sc., MCA, B.E., B.Tech, or Graduation depending on the position. The notified pay is Rs. 35,165 for Assistant Programmer and Rs. 23,350 for Accountant.

age_limit.details: Assistant Programmer: Passed M.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent from a recognized university, OR B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology or equivalent. Accountant: Passed graduation with 55% marks in B.Com. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01 January 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per general administration department norms.

qualification.details: Assistant Programmer: Passed M.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent from a recognized university, OR B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology or equivalent. Accountant: Passed graduation with 55% marks in B.Com. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01 January 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per general administration department norms.

selection_process: Selection is based on a merit list prepared from weightage on educational qualification percentage
performance in a computer practical test
and work experience weightage in government rural development schemes. Candidates must secure a minimum of 60% marks in the computer practical test.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Durg Assistant Programmer at a Glance

rows.details: M.Sc./MCA/B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT or Graduate with 55% in B.Com.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the completed application in the prescribed format by registered post or speed post to the following address: कार्यालय, मुख्य कार्यपालन अधिकारी, जिला पंचायत दुर्ग, जिला दुर्ग छ.ग. The envelope must clearly state the name of the post applied for and the category. Applications sent through any other medium will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Assistant Programmer: Passed M.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Technology / MCA or equivalent from a recognized university, OR B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology or equivalent. Accountant: Passed graduation with 55% marks in B.Com. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as on 01 January 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per general administration department norms.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of educational qualification mark sheets and certificates. Permanent caste certificate and domicile certificate issued by a competent authority. Employment exchange registration card with live registration number. Medical board certificate (for Persons with Disabilities candidates). Experience certificate (if applicable) showing work in government rural development schemes with salary details, office order, date, and contact details of issuing authority. One self-addressed empty envelope with a Rs. 5 postal stamp affixed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list prepared from weightage on educational qualification percentage, performance in a computer practical test, and work experience weightage in government rural development schemes. Candidates must secure a minimum of 60% marks in the computer practical test.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment on a permanent basis or contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for one year, subject to extension based on annual performance appraisal and mutual agreement.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Age relaxations are applicable to Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per the prevailing instructions issued by the General Administration Department from time to time.

faq.question: Q3. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants who have been dismissed from service by the government or any public sector undertaking due to indiscipline, misconduct, or negligence are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What desirable experience or work background is required for weightage?
faq.answer: Experience working in government rural development schemes with at least equivalent pay is considered for experience weightage, provided proper experience certificates with office orders and pay details are attached.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be attached with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of mark sheets, certificates, caste and domicile certificates, live employment exchange registration card, disability certificate (if applicable), experience certificates, and a self-addressed stamped envelope.
